home.heroLead: Inspections, repairs, rentals and the cost of every machine in one flow. On the phone of whoever is in the field, even without signal. On the office screen, live.
home.heroImageAlt: Crop rows in a field late in the afternoon, with low light over the soil
home.problemTitle: Today the fleet runs on improvisation
home.problemLead: In most operations, machine information lives scattered across chat groups, paper and spreadsheets.
home.problem1: Breakdowns arrive as a voice note in a group chat, without a photo of the right part or a location.
home.problem2: Mechanics spend hours looking for the machine inside the farm.
home.problem3: Rentals start and end without evidence of the machine's condition.
home.problem4: Nobody knows what each machine really costs in a season.
home.stepsTitle: How it works, in four steps
home.step1Body: Whoever is in the field reports the problem with photos, video, voice and GPS in under 2 minutes.
home.step2Body: The office creates the work order. The mechanic navigates to the machine and records parts, before and after photos and the customer's signature.
home.step3Body: Guided check-out and check-in with a checklist and photos. New damage at return becomes a report and a charge.
home.step4Body: The office sees live who is where, what is down, what is rented out and what is late.
home.offlineBody: Reports, photos, checklists and signatures are saved on the phone and upload on their own when the signal returns. Nothing is lost on the way to the office.
home.audienceTitle: For people who work with machines
home.audience1Body: Service crews who visit customers in the field and need work orders, parts and signatures in one place.
home.audience2Body: Check-out and check-in with evidence, and charges for extra hours, fuel and damage without disputes.
home.audience3Title: Farms, mills and cooperatives with their own fleet
home.audience3Body: The real cost per machine, plot and season, with preventive maintenance by hour meter.
home.modulesLead: Start with what hurts most today. The modules share the same machines, customers, farms and seasons.
home.pilotBody: We are opening guided pilots during one harvest window. Results will be published here with the participants' permission.

home.finalTitle: Try it with your crew this season
home.finalBody: Register the company in minutes, invite the crew by WhatsApp and use every module for 30 days.

faq.q1: Does it really work without internet?
faq.a1: Yes. The field app saves reports, photos, videos, voice notes, checklists and signatures on the phone and sends everything when the signal returns. You can see what is still pending.
faq.q2: Do I need to install anything on the computer?
faq.a2: No. The office uses AgroRende in the browser. The field crew uses the app on Android or iPhone.
faq.a3: The company invites each person by WhatsApp or email. People sign in with Google, Apple or email and password.
faq.q4: Does it work with machines of any brand?
faq.a4: Yes. AgroRende does not depend on manufacturer telemetry. You register the fleet, implements included, and tag each machine with a QR code.
faq.q5: What happens to my data if I cancel?
faq.a5: Your data stays available for export for 90 days after cancellation. After that, it is deleted.

recovery.AUTO: The app tries again on its own and shows the progress.
recovery.RETRY: Tap Try again. It is safe to repeat.
recovery.FIX: Fix the highlighted field; what you already typed is kept.
recovery.ALT: Use another way to finish the same task.
recovery.DRAFT: Save it as a draft and continue later from the same step.
recovery.RESTORE: The office can restore the archived record.
recovery.SETTINGS: Open the phone or browser settings, then come back to check again.
recovery.REAUTH: Sign in again without leaving the screen; nothing you did is lost.
recovery.UPDATE: Update the app; your local data is kept.
recovery.OFFICE: Contact your company's office from the app.
recovery.DIAG: Send diagnostics from the app so the office can see the problem.
recovery.HANDOFF: The office gets a notice and fixes it; you can keep working.
recovery.FALLBACK: The app shows the last information it has and tells you when things are back to normal.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account
deleteAccount.lead: You can delete your personal AgroRende account at any time, in the app or on the web.
deleteAccount.appSteps: Open Settings and tap Account|Tap Delete account|If items are waiting to send, tap Send now or Save a copy; the app does not delete the account while work is pending on the phone|Confirm the deletion
deleteAccount.webSteps: Sign in to AgroRende in the browser|Open the menu under your name and choose Account|Click Delete account and confirm
deleteAccount.keptBody: Your name, email, phone and photo are anonymized and Google or Apple access is revoked. Records the company must keep by law or contract, such as work orders, rentals, signatures and costs, stay with the company without your personal data.
deleteAccount.companyBody: The company admin cancels the subscription in Settings → Subscription. The data stays available for export for 90 days and is then deleted.
deleteAccount.noAccessBody: Write to {email} from the email address on the account. We confirm your identity and delete the account.
